title: I Took A Pill In Ibiza (Seeb Remix)
rawTtml:
I took a pill in Ibiza to show Avicii I was cool我在Ibiza岛上吃了颗药，就为了让Avicii认可我

And when I finally got sober, felt ten years older当我终于清醒过来时，我感觉我一下老了十岁

But fuck it, it was something to do但管他呢，最起码比无事可做强

I'm living out in L.A我在洛杉矶住

I drive a sports car just to prove我开了辆好车就是为了证明

I'm a real big baller 'cause I made a million dollars我是个真富豪因为我挣了大把的钱

And I spend it on girls and shoes然后我把它们在女人和球鞋上挥霍殆尽

But you don't wanna be high like me但你肯定不想和我一样曾身处顶峰

Never really knowin' why like me从来不知道我为何会是现在这样

You don't ever wanna step off that roller coaster and be all alone你肯定不想孤单一人走下过山车

You don't wanna ride the bus like this你肯定并不想经历我所经历的事

Never knowin' who to trust like this我从来找不到一个可以信任的人

You don't wanna be stuck up on that stage singin'你肯定不想在舞台上唱着

Stuck up on that stage singin'在舞台上唱着

All I know are sad songs, sad songs我所知道的只有悲歌，离歌

I get along with old timers 'cause my name's a reminder我和旧时光一样被遗忘，因为我只火过几首歌

Of a pop song people forgot而那些歌也早被遗忘

And I can't keep a girl, no而且我根本留不住一个女孩

'Cause as soon as the sun comes up因为只要太阳一出来

I cut 'em all loose and work's my excuse我就立马和她们拜拜，我用工作当作借口
